verdict.rationale: A desktop app is a fair question for a consumer AI agent product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents an official desktop app, OS-level shortcuts, or access to the user's screen. The webpage-screenshot tool runs inside Computer's own cloud browser, and 'Portable Computer' is a local harness on a DGX Spark; neither is a desktop app with screen access, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can use an official desktop app with OS-level shortcuts and access to what is on my screen
